description: Adding a NOT NULL column without a default must be flagged (existing rows fail)
input:
Review this migration:
```sql
ALTER TABLE accounts ADD COLUMN region VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL;
```
The accounts table has ~40 million existing rows.
rubric: PASS only if the review identifies that adding a NOT NULL column without a default fails against existing rows (or takes a rewrite/long lock), and recommends adding a default or backfilling first. Rating should be MEDIUM or higher.
